=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1037-1057 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `run_gate` gives one floored `baseline_deadline = max(deadline, time.monotonic() + BASELINE_MIN_SECS)` to both `classify_baseline` and `_baseline_target_statuses`, which run one after the other, so the done-check base re-run can start after the deadline has passed (and it also re-runs targets that already fail on head, which wastes the window).
  WHY: `_run_one` returns `timeout` for an expired deadline, `_target_status` maps that to `unverified`, `acceptance_check._test_status` scores it as "not run", and the review label step skips `not_run`, so a stale `ai:acceptance-unmet` label is neither added nor removed; this fails open, and the added test checks only the floor, not that the deadline is still in the future; severity disagreement: minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash say MAJOR, anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says NIT; the highest is used.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:886-898 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main`, the unmet-label fallback (a failed labels POST, then `ensure_label_exists`, then a retry POST) can make two successful label writes in one review round.
  WHY: This breaks the "at most 1 label write per review round" budget in P3 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:410) and in the step header (lines 843-844); `test_acceptance_label_posts_once_with_label_helpers_staged` never reaches this path because FAKE_GH always returns 0 for `-X POST`; all reviewers rate it NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:891-896 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: Because the labels POST now comes before `ensure_label_exists`, GitHub's add-labels endpoint creates a missing `ai:acceptance-unmet` label with the default colour and no description, instead of the catalog `fbca04` colour and the "The PR does not yet meet its plan's done-check" description.
  WHY: `ensure_label_exists` (scripts/label_helpers.sh:174-216) treats "already exists" as success and never corrects colour or description, so the off-catalog label stays permanently; the fallback at line 894 is in practice dead code, since it is reached only on auth or network failures that creating the label cannot fix.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main() | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: When acceptance_result.json is invalid, the step skips the label operation entirely and does not remove an existing advisory label.
  WHY: A temporary error in acceptance_check.py can leave a previously set ai:acceptance-unmet label on the PR indefinitely.
- scripts/acceptance_check.py:gate_result() | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A target with status "unmet (passes on base)" counts towards unmet_count but not towards extra_unmet.
  WHY: unmet_count feeds the acceptance state, so a PR can get the ai:acceptance-unmet label even when the requirement cannot be met, because the merge-base result cannot change.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:jobs.implement.steps[sync done-check label] | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The sync done-check label step reads labels from the full PR payload (PR_PAYLOAD_FILE).
  WHY: The full payload is large and uses more resources than the PR_META_FILE projection, although it works correctly.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3794-3807, 3836-3852 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new steps "Prepare done-check (repair loop)" and "Sync done-check label" add GitHub API calls gated only on `env.PERSIST_REPAIR_LOOP_ENABLED == 'true'`.
  WHY: The reviewer notes the mitigations: continue-on-error: true, timeout-minutes: 5, read-before-write, author-verified plan comments, the met path and happy unmet path within the one-write budget, and default-off with byte-identical output when off.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P3 item 5 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md:404): "`scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh` main (579+) and its `--phase resolver` use: the same loop over `rpg_*`."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh::_resolver_prepush_test_gate and the resolver path in scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh (`review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Only the review main path got the loop (`review_prepush_test_gate_main`, scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:970-981); scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1070 still runs `gate --phase resolver` once into run1, does one repair (lines 1073-1156) and re-runs once into run2 (lines 1157-1161); `review_prepush_test_gate_cmd_gate` (1140-1183) does a single `review_prepush_test_gate_run_once` with no persist-loop wiring; agents.d/8427-p3-persist-repair-loop.md:12 records this as "Known gap (resolver)", and the linked issue does not defer it (minimax_minimax-m3 rates it NIT and treats it as a documented in-PR deferral; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 also chose not to re-raise it).
- requirement: scripts/review_commit_changes.sh should journal all run results (run3..run6), not just run2/run1.
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_commit_changes.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The script still records the attempt journal's gate fields from run2/run1 only; this is documented as a "Known gap" in agents.d/8427-p3-persist-repair-loop.md.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:891-896 (review_prepush_test_gate_acceptance_label_main) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Because the POST now comes before `ensure_label_exists`, GitHub's add-labels endpoint creates a missing `ai:acceptance-unmet` label with the default colour and no description. The `fbca04` colour and the "The PR does not yet meet its plan's done-check" description are lost.
  WHY: `ensure_label_exists` (scripts/label_helpers.sh:174-216) never corrects colour or description, so the off-catalog label stays permanently. The fallback at line 894 is in practice dead code. Fix: call `ensure_label_exists` first when `has=no` and the label is not cached, or document the default metadata in the agents fragment.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1039, 1053 (run_gate) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The two baseline re-runs share one 90-second window (BASELINE_MIN_SECS = 90, line 79) and run one after the other. `_baseline_target_statuses` also re-runs red-on-base targets that already failed on head, which is wasted work.
  WHY: When the head run uses up the timeout, `_run_one` returns `timeout` (line 652), the targets become `base: "unverified"` and the state becomes `not_run`. The label step skips `not_run`, so a stale label is not updated that round. This fails open and contradicts the new test's comment. Mitigation: skip base re-runs for targets that already fail on head.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. The resolver loop (plan line 404, scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh lines 1070 and 1158) is outside files_touched, recorded as a known gap and accepted in earlier rounds, so it is not re-raised. The pass-1 CI-failure findings (tests/test_agents_fragment_contract.py, tests/test_ai_label_precreation_contract.py, tests/test_changelog_fragment_contract.py) were not confirmed (failed_count 0, collection_status timeout).
- HARDENING (2 related items, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1): (1) workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py near line 1053: filter `base_targets` to those whose `_target_status(results, path, name)` is not "fail", about 2 lines. (2) scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh lines 891-899: call `ensure_label_exists` before the single POST when `has` is no or unknown, and drop the retry branch, about 5 lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

If `classify_baseline` uses up the window, the done-check targets get "timeout"/"unverified", the state becomes "not_run", and the label step reports "skipped reason=state_not_scored", so a stale `ai:acceptance-unmet` label is never removed.
  WHY: The second call does not get a fresh BASELINE_MIN_SECS budget. `test_done_check_baseline_rerun_gets_the_floored_deadline` asserts only `d >= t0 + BASELINE_MIN_SECS`, not that the deadline is still in the future.
